mapper.select: SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.member.mapper.DropInfoMapper.selectDropUsrInfo */ vm.user_uid, vm.user_email, vm.user_pwd, vm.bl_yn, vm.user_pwd_init_yn FROM seinfo_vendor_manager vm WHERE vm.user_uid = #{userUid}

/* com.seinfo.protoA.component.member.mapper.DropInfoMapper.selectMfileList */ SELECT ml.mfile_id AS file_id ,ml.mfile_path AS mfile_path ,ml.mfile_group_id AS mfile_grp_id FROM seinfo_mfile_list ml JOIN seinfo_mfile_group mg ON ml.mfile_group_id = mg.mfile_group_id JOIN seinfo_proposal pr ON pr.mfile_group_id = mg.mfile_group_id JOIN seinfo_vendor_manager vm ON pr.user_uid = vm.user_uid WHERE vm.user_uid = #{userUid} UNION SELECT ml.mfile_id AS file_id ,ml.mfile_path AS mfile_path ,ml.mfile_group_id AS mfile_grp_id FROM seinfo_mfile_list ml JOIN seinfo_mfile_group mg ON ml.mfile_group_id = mg.mfile_group_id JOIN seinfo_request_cont rc ON rc.mfile_group_id = mg.mfile_group_id JOIN seinfo_proposal pr2 ON rc.proposal_no = pr2.proposal_no JOIN seinfo_vendor_manager vm2 ON pr2.user_uid = vm2.user_uid WHERE vm2.user_uid = #{userUid}
